'''2014 European Championship Reset Beta Marc Nickels LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Marc Nickels]] at [[2014 European Championship Reset Beta]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Marc Nickels]]
* '''Event:''' [[2014 European Championship Reset Beta]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Heading For The Medical Frigate]]
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2014-europeans-reset-beta-event-3rd-place-ls-marc-nickels-hidden-base/ PC list]
